Direct presidential diplomacy also restored military communications and arms-control and AI channels with China (E022), while the broader foreign-policy assessment credits substantial Ukraine assistance and de-escalatory management but notes repeated hesitation over weapons decisions (E018). Execution was therefore real and cross-domain, with evidence of coordination and some adaptation, but not consistently fast or complete: the formal Russia arms-control proposal was still absent months after the announced initiative (E007), GAO identified cross-agency spending, grants, fraud-control, and expertise risks (E042), and OMB management goals were incomplete or inconsistently reported (E054). The evidence supports generally effective but uneven competence, not strong durable mastery across the full portfolio.
